snippet.title: Untold Stories 8: Burnout Fantasy Trailer
snippet.description:
RenderXR and Asometric present: Burnout Fantasy

This is a survival-focused 12 objective Complete The Monument map. Explore the sprawling terrain, fight hordes of monsters, and build to make the world your own. Fight bosses in the hunting grounds to obtain resources and objectives. The map uses hot custom graphics which don't require additional mods.

Download the map here: https://ctmrepository.com/index.php?action=viewMap&id=335
